title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 20, 2026 at 18:36 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 426 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Sunspots look dark because they're cooler than the surrounding surface — but they're still extremely hot. ☀️🌎

Several active regions and sunspot groups are visible today, with especially bright activity near the Sun’s right limb.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
